title: Confidence-Weighted Reservations: usage proofs, rolling tranches, and automated rollover
creator: Aisha Kumar
description: Summary: Experiment with a Confidence-Weighted Reservation product aimed at large platform customers who need capacity predictability but have spiky/seasonal workloads. The product sells capacity in 'tranches' (rolling micro-reservations) where each tranche has a confidence score derived from historical usage and a small flexible rollover buffer. Tranches can be auto-expanded or reclaimed based on predictive signals and an agreed SLA ladder that gracefully degrades latency/SLOs before triggering capacity preemption.
background_and_motivation: Many enterprise customers dislike large annual GPU commitments because they either overpay for idle capacity or suffer shortage during bursts. Existing reserved + burst models either force large minimum commitments or complex legal terms. The confidence-weighted model aims to balance predictability and flexibility: customers commit to a primary capacity band (higher confidence) and buy supplemental tranches on a 30/60/90-day rolling cadence, with automated rollover and negotiated grace reclaim rules.
goals: Design a pricing rubric for tranches (base rate, tranche premium, rollover discount)
Prototype billing and accounting flows for rolling commitments and prorated credits
Define SLA ladder (gold/silver/bronze) and explicit latency/throughput degradations tied to tranche reclaiming
Build a canary pilot with 3 enterprise customers and measure cost predictability and utilization improvements
Produce a contract amendment template and security questionnaire answers needed for enterprise legal review
acceptance_criteria: Pricing rubric documented with clear per-GPU-minute rates for base and tranche bands
Billing prototype converts rolling tranche usage to credits and shows correct proration in sandbox billing reports
SLA ladder documented and validated with infra (SRE) for preemption behavior and fallback model routing
Pilot onboarding playbook, sales FAQ, and legal contract amendment draft are reviewed by Sales and Legal
Telemetry dashboard shows >=10% increase in average committed utilization for pilot customers without >5% increase in latency violations
success_metrics: Pilot conversion rate: >=50% of pilot customers sign 6-month tranche rollouts
Committed utilization increase: +10% median across pilots
Billing accuracy: 0 reconciliation issues reported in first two billing cycles
Customer NPS on pricing: >=+20 for pilot cohort
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (Design): finalize pricing rubric, SLA ladder, legal contract language - 3 weeks
Phase 1 (Prototype): implement billing prototype and sandbox dashboard; infra feature toggles for tranche reclaim - 4 weeks
Phase 2 (Pilot): 3 enterprise customers onboarded for 90-day trials; weekly checkpoints with Sales/CS - 12 weeks
Phase 3 (Evaluate & Adjust): metric analysis, contract updates, automation for tranche lifecycle - 2 weeks
Phase 4 (GA): public pricing page, updated sales playbooks, product docs - contingent on pilot outcomes
open_questions: What minimum tranche length do Sales want to push (30d vs 90d) for enterprise renewal cycles?
How should overage vs preemption penalties be priced to align incentives?
Can we safely automate tranche reclaiming without manual CS approval for tiered customers?
What telemetry thresholds should SRE expose to ensure we trigger graceful degradations rather than hard preemptions?
customer_profile_for_pilot: Large SaaS platform (multi-tenant) with predictable weekday peaks and sporadic marketing-driven bursts
Willingness to sign 3-6 month commercial pilots with flexible terms
Requires SOC2 and basic KMS integration; no full air-gapped requirements
legal_and_compliance_notes: Contract amendment needs an appendix describing reclaim windows, notice periods, and credit calculation
Security questionnaire: confirm that tranche billing does not change data residency; provide KMS/HSM answers
Escalation path for customers if automated reclaim causes critical incidents
implementation_notes: Billing team to add a tranche_credit ledger line item and test proration logic in sandbox
Scheduler to expose a reclaim API that accepts confidence score thresholds and a grace TTL
Console: add tranche management UI (view active tranches, next scheduled rollover, predicted reclaim risk)
Telemetry: add per-customer tranche utilization and projected next-30d confidence percentage
